newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary '96 trade gap target reachable - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Hungary '96 trade gap target reachable - ministry.

text.p: Hungary expects to meet its 1996 foreign trade deficit target of between $2.0 billion and $2.5 billion, a Trade and Industry Ministry (IKM) official said on Tuesday.

"The net foreign trade gap would probably be slightly below two billion dollars, while the gross foreign trade gap slightly over two billion dollars," Berenyi Lajos, secretary of state at IKM told a news conference.
